        # Perform convolution (autoconvolution) using more precise method
        g = np.convolve(f, f, mode='full')

        l2_sq = np.sum(g_abs**2)

        l_inf = np.max(g_abs)
        
        # Use stricter thresholds and better numerical handling
        epsilon = 1e-12
        if l1 > epsilon and l_inf > epsilon:

        else:
